# Gyan Aangan

> Free, structured engineering study resources, syllabus, notes, and previous year question papers for college students.

## Quick Links
- [Home](https://gyanaangan.in/): Gyan Aangan homepage.
- [Courses](https://gyanaangan.in/courses): Browse university engineering courses and branches.
- [Subjects](https://gyanaangan.in/subjects): Explore subjects and syllabus.
- [Resources](https://gyanaangan.in/resources): Download past year question papers (PYQs), handwritten notes, and solutions.
- [Blog](https://gyanaangan.in/blog): Read articles on engineering, AI agents, technology, and developer guides.
- [About Us](https://gyanaangan.in/about): Learn more about the Gyan Aangan mission and community.
